reference_sql:
WITH numbered AS (  -- one row per BE-14 order line of 2024 as stored, numbered within its set of copies
  SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) AS order_month,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur) AS n_copies,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur ORDER BY ol.order_line_id) AS copy_no
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT order_month, SUM(n_copies) AS n_stored, COUNT(*) AS n_kept
FROM numbered
WHERE copy_no = 1
GROUP BY order_month

WITH line_sets AS (  -- one row per order line, its copies counted together
  SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS n_copies
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.order_ts), ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur
)
SELECT order_month, SUM(n_copies) AS n_stored, COUNT(*) AS n_kept
FROM line_sets
GROUP BY order_month

SELECT order_month, SUM(n_copies) AS n_stored, COUNT(*) AS n_kept
FROM (
  -- one row per order line: the copy with the lowest order_line_id
  SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) AS order_month,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur) AS n_copies
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur ORDER BY ol.order_line_id) = 1
) AS kept
GROUP BY order_month

solver.query:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT ol.order_line_id, ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur,
         CAST(date_trunc('month', CAST(o.order_ts AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) AS order_month,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur ORDER BY ol.order_line_id) AS rn
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14'
    AND CAST(o.order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND CAST(o.order_ts AS TIMESTAMP) < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT order_month, COUNT(*) AS n_stored, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS n_kept
FROM l
GROUP BY order_month
